title: Update `Node::get_path_to` algorithm

milestone.title: 4.x
milestone.description: Issues and pull requests slated for an undetermined Godot 4 release.

body:
## What problem(s) does this PR solve?

- Closes #122411

The basic algorithm for `get_path_to` is the same, but I fixed some missed edge cases (calls from an owner node). This PR only modifies behavior for `get_path_to` when called with `use_unique_path == true`.

In a sentence:
- If the destination node is unique, and can be accessed using that unique name, `get_path_to` will now always return a path that utilizes the unique name (when called with `use_unique_path == true`).

## Examples

To document what changed, below are all the possible scenarios where `get_path_to` will return a different path than before.

The examples below will use the following scene tree:
```
Root (owner of all other nodes in scene)
`- A1
  `- A2 (can be accessed with unique name prefixed with %)
    `- A3
```

### Case 1 - Path from an owner to a unique node
This was the primary problem in the issue.
Example: `Root.get_path_to(A2)`
Before: `A1/A2`
After: `%A2`

### Case 2 - Path from an owner to a unique node's descendent
It will now use the unique name so that a shorter path is returned.
Example: `Root.get_path_to(A3)`
Before: `A1/A2/A3`
After: `%A2/A3`

### Case 3 - Path to an ancestor unique node
It will now use the unique name instead of a series of `..`
Example: `A3.get_path_to(A2)`
Before: `..`
After: `%A2`
Consider the difference between `GreatGreatGrandchild.get_path_to(UniqueAncestor)` previously returning `../../../..` vs now just returning `%UniqueAncestor`. A shorter path is not always better, but if the method is called with `use_unique_path == true`, the intention is to use the unique name if there is one.

## Testing

I used this project (along with a test build where I used a custom `get_path_to_old` method which was the current code for `get_path_to`) to test all imaginable differences:
[unique_names.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/32693923/unique_names.zip)

## Other changes

- Added a few comments for readability
- Removed redundant code at the beginning of `get_path_to` which was identical to just calling `Node::find_common_parent_with`
